title: Arrival in town
note: Cue times are movie seconds (the Mana clock). Each cue must end before its gap does (build/ad/<id>.gaps.json).

cues.text: A huge sun sinks behind golden clouds.
From high above, a city crosswalk. People stream across, their long shadows stretching in the evening light.
Tall buildings glow orange along a wide street at sunset.
Crowds wait in a shadowed plaza, chatting and checking their phones.
People line up outside a bright café.
A slim teenage boy in a black school uniform walks through the crowd, earphones in.
He passes a group crouched on the pavement, and keeps walking.
Three young men gaze up at a glass tower.
Elsewhere, a schoolgirl stands alone by a door.
A gun at her temple.
She drops the gun and sinks to her knees.
In darkness, a glowing blue butterfly drifts.
The boy walks out across the empty station.
A full moon shines through the glass roof.
He crosses the hall to the ticket gates and steps through.
A station clock. Both hands point to twelve.
The lights die. The whole station turns a sickly green.
The moon looms, huge and yellow, in a green sky.
The boy looks around. His face doesn't change.
He climbs the stairs out of the station.
Outside, the square is silent. Dark pools of blood stain the pavement.
He stands still, looking ahead, as the picture fades.
